column1: # Titan H0062 chip volume table (apps/core/lumen-audio ChipTable). Stock v1299 services.jar carries the same
# setDspVolumesToHal keys as the X50 G0111 (spk / headphone / bluetooth with ;device= / usb / xgimi_pcm, 2026-11-15).
out     8     bluetooth_volume  128     3     # A2DP: DEVICE_OUT_ALL_A2DP_SET 0x80 / 0x100 / 0x200, ";device=" per id
out     6     xgimi_pcm_volume  -       1     # SPDIF 0x80000: the optical jack, stock audio.ini spdif_jack_type 1, threadInit path 1
out     10    -                 -       2     # HDMI ARC: no chip key, the soundbar keeps its own volume
path    0                                     # every other output: the speaker path (threadInit default)
# Not listed: the USB accessory 0x2000, the BLE set and the hearing aid of the same stock method (no Lumen media route
# reaches them), the XGIMI wireless speaker set (xgimi_wlspk_volume, no AudioDeviceInfo type).
